method: Seventeenth independent live pass (renumbered P17b to avoid colliding with the peer session arena/36ebce13-gold3’s already-merged pass P17) on the main tip 85ac1fa (PR #66). Re-opened the gold-spot benchmark and every feed that corroborates it, plus a rotating sample of the highest-priced and weight-bearing R* rows, the weight-bearing Dataset C SOL/BND rows, and the Menē rows that were already known to re-price. Every stored price/weight/policy value was searched for verbatim on the live page. Captured prices are never overwritten; a new live reading is recorded beside them in live_recheck.history. Publishes data/reverification-p17.json and reports/reverification-pass-p17.md.
integration_note: Additive. No peer file was edited: the dated calculation anchor, the F1-F49 findings and the P1-P16 ledger are preserved. The P17b live readings are appended, the two Menē rows that moved again get a new history entry, and the Wide Flat Band page that was HTTP 500 in P12 is now readable. The only generator change is that the calculator's labelled live-check reading now selects the newest live-check snapshot instead of the first.

checks.label: GoldPrice.org live reading has drifted further below the dated anchor
checks.findings: Read 2026-10-23T23:43Z: 'Spot Gold Price: USD 3,995.88 / Ounce | Spot Silver Price: USD 53.92 / Ounce Oct 23rd, 2026 at 07:41 NY Time'. The dated primary snapshot is $4,022.22/oz, so the live reading is 0.655% below it. The calculation anchor is deliberately kept dated and reproducible; the live reading is recorded here and shown on the calculator, never fed into the melt arithmetic. Published as finding F50.
